notes: 171 discovery candidates were found across 34 adapters; they remain unreviewed until publication date and body verification.
A successful HTTP response is recorded as not_checked unless publication dates or content deltas were parsed.
Static pages were not promoted as fresh based on collected_at alone.
OpenAI and other curl-blocked pages are recorded as access_blocked rather than no-match.

candidate_reviews.reason: body and metadata document a production multi-agent architecture with tenant-scoped grounding, deterministic readiness scoring, per-agent observability and deployment rollback; launch timing and performance remain vendor-reported
the body provides a durable eight-step customization and escalation framework tied to explicit failure modes; selected as P2 research, not a product launch
body and companion repository expose a reproducible detect-decide-act workflow, unattended-write configuration, human exception routing and authentication boundaries
the body is an Oracle database migration guide; Oracle 26ai is a database version name and the article contains no material model, agent, AI product or AI industry-structure event
the page confirms only that Google is exploring a possible Lea County data center; it gives no size, capital commitment, capacity, AI workload, energy agreement or executed project state
the first-party page is dated August 3 with visible updates through September 1; the September 14 sitemap lastmod does not identify a new filing, product event or body update

Simon Willison's post is only a quotation; editorial selection was moved to Laurie Voss's complete first-party article, which states its assumptions, thesis, current agent limits and long-term training risk
